claims.claim: Direct tokunbo Japan highest grade Rogue and Altima gearbox
claims.evidence: Witness only reports an exposed car transmission/gearbox assembly with wiring/hoses and oil/grime; no brand/model/part number, VIN, or compatibility markings were read from the unit.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the gearbox may not match Nissan Rogue/Altima (wrong variant/part number), especially since no identifying markings were visible.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the transmission ID/part number label and casting marks (and/or the vehicle VIN/part number cross-reference) on the casing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-verified, potentially incompatible used transmission/engine-transmission assembly (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: Condition risk: the unit appears opened/partially disassembled with heavy grime/oil staining; internal wear or damage may exist.
risks.proof: Video/clip showing the unit fully assembled (covers on), plus close-ups of internal components (clutch packs/torque converter area) and any visible damage/metal shavings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to be working (worst-case: may require rebuild).

risks.risk: Leak/contamination risk: oil staining and floor marks suggest possible leaks or contaminated fluid; seals/bushings may be failing.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the transmission after cleaning with a fresh inspection for leaks, and a shot of fluid level/condition (or evidence it was drained and refilled).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially leaking/unknown fluid condition (worst-case: reseal/flush needed).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: top cover removed/absent and multiple ports/sensors visible—missing sensors, bolts, covers, or internal parts could reduce value and prevent installation.
risks.proof: Inventory-style photos showing all sensors/solenoids, connectors, bolts, covers, and that nothing is missing; include a checklist shot of the full set.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing parts).

risks.risk: Testing risk: no evidence of functional testing (gear engagement, reverse, shifting quality, or operation).
risks.proof: Video of the transmission tested in a vehicle/bench setup showing engagement of gears and no abnormal noises, plus a leak check during/after.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested (worst-case: may not engage properly).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the transmission ID/part number label and any casting numbers on the casing.
Send a video showing the transmission fully assembled (all covers/ports sealed) and demonstrate gear engagement/reverse (or bench test).
Send photos after cleaning to confirm there are no active leaks, and show fluid condition/level if applicable.
Provide an inventory photo list of all sensors/solenoids, connectors, bolts, and covers included (confirm nothing is missing).
Confirm whether it is manual or automatic and the exact variant (with markings visible on the unit).
response.reason: The witness can identify it only as a car transmission/gearbox assembly with wiring/hoses, but key details needed to price it safely (exact variant/compatibility, completeness, and working condition) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is required before a reliable worst-case price can be set.
